info.title: Bean Bloom Coffee — Agent API (demo)
info.description: Demo only. Small-batch roasted coffee beans, shipped from Yunnan. No real orders are taken. Agent-first storefront at https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/ Paths in this document are absolute from the host root, e.g. /shops/bean-bloom/llms.txt.

200.description: Full shop corpus: products and policies
Product list with price and stock

post.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP (demo: documented, not live on GitHub Pages)
post.description: In production this is POST /shops/bean-bloom/mcp, Streamable HTTP, tools: list_products, get_product, create_order (mock), get_order. GitHub Pages is static-only, so this demo documents the endpoint in mcp.json instead of serving a live MCP server. See README.md / DISCOVERY.md.

200.description: Shopping-assistant guide: conversation flow, questions, recommendations
Structured recommendations, bundles and free-shipping tips
Canonical presentation IR: products, options, actions, totals, Markdown fallback, per-client adapters
